# Observability Standard

## Purpose

Define organization-wide observability expectations for telemetry and diagnostics work.

## Scope

- Applies to tracing, logging, metrics, and operational visibility.
- Captures organizational observability themes and review boundaries.
- Avoids provider- or framework-specific implementation guidance.

## Ownership

- Primary owner: observability platform maintainers.
- Reviewers: engineering, cloud, and runtime stakeholders.

## Review Process

- Keep the standard short and reusable.
- Confirm it expresses organizational expectations rather than tool instruction.
- Avoid duplicating observability module content.

## Future Content

- Telemetry governance themes.
- Diagnostic workflow expectations.
- Cost and signal-to-noise expectations.
- Observability review checkpoints.
